purpose: Historical preservation of closed, unmerged PR #107; owner-authorized abandoned experiment cleanup
owner_disposition: PR #107 was abandoned for artistic reasons, not because of a performance or gameplay failure. The owner found the disturbed-earth and skid-mark treatment insufficiently impactful and preferred the existing ship/contact-shadow presentation.

pr_snapshot.body:
Integrates the owner-approved disturbed-earth concept as one reversible, noncolliding Sprite2D beneath the approved contact shadow and hull. Based on merged PR #106 at 029e1d54958d6259940cf44e4b5f56fb53bc0133. The original PNG remains preserved in Git at initial implementation eee70da59aa0cfbe26b518517cdc5502b9ce8855.

Owner initial gameplay review: **4/6 PASS**. Artwork alignment FAIL; skid-mark placement PASS; visual intensity FAIL; terrain blending PASS; hatch/gameplay clearance PASS; performance PASS (owner observation, no benchmark). The supplied screenshot shows a detached soil ridge above/left of the nose, while rear furrows are barely visible. Best-supported explanation: the initial broad-patch guide did not register its ridge contour to the actual grounded hull. A global translation would also move the accepted rear placement.

Correction: localized deterministic forward warp, plus selective rear channel/ridge contrast. Sprite transform is UNCHANGED: world top-left (-1334,-1122), scale (1,1), zero rotation, centered=false, Z=-2. Terrain Z=-11, shadow Z=-1, hull Z=0 and existing Y sorting remain unchanged.

Exact image correction (source pixel coordinates; S denotes cubic smoothstep):
- Forward displacement (80,55) * (1-S(650,900,x)) * S(550,800,y), inverse-mapped with 16 fixed-point iterations and premultiplied-alpha bilinear sampling in X=230..899, Y=550..1159. This tucks the forward patch inward while tapering to untouched hatch/rear coordinates.
- Rear masks use distance d to unchanged segments (1030,650)-(1820,245) and (1250,755)-(1850,375), evaluated in X=1050..1919, Y=180..859. Channel=1-S(14,48,d); ridge=S(24,36,d)*(1-S(48,72,d)); gate=S(1050,1200,x)*S(8,56,alpha). RGB multiplier=1-0.50*channel*gate+0.12*ridge*gate; alpha adds 0.55*channel*gate*(255-alpha), rounded/clamped to bytes. No blanket opacity multiplier; rear alpha <=8 is unchanged and no new rear painted support is added.

Asset: assets/environment/exterior/disturbed_earth_skid_marks_v1.png
Original SHA-256: 7d32263726b6c84c12e8687dfd31e296bddd82e62f25e13fc7c47058784e4cb1
Corrected SHA-256: 35b4576aba05c8de76b9b6adde56376a219bae8b76e5e09239bc8d2f4efcdf7d

Focused static validation PASS:
- Exact deterministic regeneration from original Git blob; PNG chunk CRC/decode and RGBA 2200 x 1300 retained. Alpha 0..253; 2,459,740 transparent and 400,260 partially transparent pixels.
- Exactly 221,968 forward and 72,206 rear pixels changed within the stated regions. Rear coordinates/directions retained; both channel cores measurably darken and gain alpha. Low-alpha rear feathering is unchanged.
- Corrected source alpha bounds [340,216)..[1879,1156) map to world [-994,-906)..[545,34). Source rectangle X=900..1000, Y=900..1110 around hatch/spawn/approach is pixel-identical.
- Entire scene byte-equivalent to initial implementation after line-ending normalization: references, sprite transform, layer order, shadow/hull registration, three convex collisions, hatch/spawn and existing sorting unchanged. Approved ship and shadow PNGs are byte-identical. No camera, terrain, construction, Ferrite, gameplay or hidden legacy visual changes.
- Only PNG and scoped README record changed in this correction; documentation-sync, Markdown link and git diff --check pass. All 45 pre-existing untracked files remain hash-identical. Existing owner files and evidence preserved.

A local ignored static before/after registration composition uses the actual approved hull and shadow on a plain background. This is asset inspection, not an in-game screenshot or Weathered Earth blending verification. No Godot, imports, native tests, gameplay launches or benchmarks were run.

**Owner graphical retest pending; no final acceptance.** Ready for owner-controlled screenshot review of nose fit, skid visibility, soft terrain blending and hatch clearance. Hide DisturbedEarth for rollback. Separate debris, salvage, hatch animation, foreground occlusion and camera work remain deferred. Do not merge automatically.
